notes: Oracle for docs/mc68010-boot-findings.md section 21. Every $25E8 character draw executes 'move.l D0,$c00002.l' at PC $2656, so filtering on that PC alone captures one event per character drawn; 1040 taps = 520 host-address writes (each 32-bit move.l splits into two 16-bit taps). Requires the f084039 harness fix: before it, --registers dropped every event on the MC68010 because ram-write-trace.lua indexed device.state['A10'].value, which only the TMS34010 has. Frames 214-216 draw selector $47 and frames 334-336 draw selector $43, with A0 = descriptor+5+char_index (move.b (A0)+ at $2638 runs before the write) and A1 = $1FBC + 16*(char-$2A), which is how the first glyph reads 'P'. Cross-checked against the committed screens/frame-000300.png in service-f2-3600-stages, which show 'PRESS START TO BYPASS SELFTEST' -- selector $47.
